biggest_fights.name: Old Bonegrinder
biggest_fights.why: The hags' lightning dropped most of the party, killed Zarr, and left Azza barely stable by the door.

biggest_fights.name: Battle in the Ravenloft crypts
biggest_fights.why: The party crossed a running battle between Strahd and the revenant knights to reach Sergei's crypt. Gurn fell to Rahadin as the others escaped.

biggest_fights.name: The Abbot's last stand
biggest_fights.why: A last counterspell spared the party from a sphere of death before the Sunsword consumed the Abbot.

biggest_fights.name: Escher and the Guardian
biggest_fights.why: Roger tore out Escher's throat with his werewolf fangs, and the Guardian crumbled to dust. Escher was the first of Strahd's consorts the party defeated.

biggest_fights.name: Anastrasya's final waltz
biggest_fights.why: Anastrasya repeatedly dropped party members with fireballs while the organ music kept Ezmerelda dancing. Roger killed Anastrasya with his final strike.

biggest_fights.name: The fight at Vampyr's tomb
biggest_fights.why: The party fought in a chamber with sheer drops. Hrulek impaled the likeness of his former master on his glaive and later decapitated Scrippy.

biggest_fights.name: The meteor strike
biggest_fights.why: Zadkiel forced Ludmilla to retreat with the Sunsword, but a Wall of Force blocked the exit. The meteors killed Zadkiel and reduced Hrulek to ash.

legendary_items.name: Sunsword
legendary_items.how_found: Zarcharus placed the sword in Sergei's hand in the Ravenloft crypts, where it began to charge. It later flew into Zadkiel's hand when he descended in a beam of sunlight.

legendary_items.name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
legendary_items.how_found: Vladimir gave the party the necklace at Argynvostholt after Argynvost appeared and Vladimir acknowledged that rage had consumed him.

legendary_items.name: Jefferson
legendary_items.how_found: Rudolf van Richten gave Korino a suit of half plate inhabited by the soul of an accountant.

legendary_items.name: The Seeker's cloak
legendary_items.how_found: The Seeker wrapped Hrulek in the cloak after he spoke a difficult truth. The cloak revealed creatures' vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities.

legendary_items.name: Ireena's locket
legendary_items.how_found: Strahd gave the locket to Ireena on Strahdmas. It glowed in his presence.

places_visited: Rudolf van Richten's tower and laboratory

closest_calls.what: The party fled Death House after the cult's demand for a sacrifice brought out a shambling mound and five spectres.
Korino got back up on a natural 20 and crawled to the fane with Baba Yaga standing over it.
The party fled Krezk under Strahd's chain lightning. Hrulek carried Lucy out after she went down, and Boondaego died after going back in.
A Death Ward and Jefferson's magic kept Korino alive through three legendary attacks that tore open his chest.
After Ludmilla reduced Hrulek to ash, Korino's wish brought him before Nhazul. Korino pledged his soul after death, and Hrulek was reassembled from ash.
The meteor strike left Zadkiel dead and Hrulek in ashes. Strahd returned Zadkiel's body and offered a potion and a way out.

party_firsts.what: Escaped Death House and found a welcome basket signed S.
Saw a party member revived after death when Strahd brought Zarr back on Strahdmas.
Received the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind from Vladimir.
Saw Korino cast Wish, asking to restore the party to its state at dawn.
